authority: This catalog defines selected standards and phase ownership for the CSS foundation. Source code and behavior-revealing tests establish implementation status; catalog membership is not evidence of implementation.

selection_policy.snapshot_membership: The four module lists in sections 2.1 through 2.4 of the pinned Snapshot select module identities and tiers. Their bibliographic edition dates do not override the publication-cutoff policy.
selection_policy.published_edition: For each selected W3C module, use the latest published edition available at the cutoff. latest_published_url records the discovery endpoint; publication.url and its hash identify the selected representation. Live editor drafts are not substitute editions.
selection_policy.withdrawn_publication: Use a published withdrawal only as supersession evidence. Follow its explicitly identified canonical successor for the same selected module, pinning an immutable successor snapshot at or before the cutoff. Fullscreen is the sole such transition in this catalog.
selection_policy.supersession: Apply explicit replacement definitions from a selected successor to overlapping requirements; retain older definitions that the successor imports or leaves unchanged. A higher level number alone does not imply wholesale replacement. Count shared requirements once under their effective defining source while retaining module membership.
selection_policy.normative_dependencies: Import only definitions necessary to interpret or validate a selected requirement. Prefer the already selected edition of an in-profile dependency. For an out-of-profile definition, record the defining module, exact section, dated or immutable source identity, and hash with the requirement evidence before relying on it. Do not select that dependency module in full or silently follow moving editor links.
selection_policy.draft_omissions: A requirement may be classified unresolved-standard only when an exact pinned source section demonstrably omits or leaves that requirement undefined. Cite the omission and owning phase. Defined authored grammar remains required even when its execution algorithm is unfinished.
selection_policy.hashes: SHA-256 and byte counts cover the retrieved HTTP body bytes before text decoding or whitespace normalization. Retrieval uses curl without automatic content decompression. Repository hashes cover git blob bytes. HTML document hashes do not include externally linked assets; CSS2 chapter and errata documents have individual hashes.
selection_policy.status: This catalog contains target scope, source identities, and owner classifications, not progress flags. Evidence and unresolved implementation findings belong in the CSS conformance ledger and owning tests.

authored_scope_definitions.complete-applicable-grammar: All defined authored properties, descriptors, selectors, at-rules, queries, functions, value productions, intrinsic restrictions, recovery rules, shorthand contributions, and applicable context-independent serialization in the selected effective definitions. Includes checked typed Rust construction. Does not claim execution or contextual validity without the required context.
authored_scope_definitions.referenced-grammar: The module adds an API or execution model and consumes CSS grammars defined elsewhere. CSS supplies shared parsing, checked construction, and serialization for those referenced definitions; no duplicate grammar or live API is introduced here.
authored_scope_definitions.none: The module contributes no independently authored stylesheet syntax. Its selection is retained and its requirements belong to the listed downstream owners.
authored_scope_definitions.named-property-exception: Only explicitly named authored property grammar is selected; the remainder of the external module is not selected.

owners.css: surgeist-css: authored semantic models, intrinsic grammar/recovery, specified-value facts, checked construction, expansion, context-preserving normalization, and canonical serialization.
owners.style: surgeist-style: selector/query evaluation, live CSSOM state, cascade/inheritance, custom-property environments, contextual validation, computed values, and invalidation.
owners.layout: surgeist-layout: formatting, sizing, positioning, fragmentation, and geometry requiring a layout tree or available space.
owners.render: surgeist-render: paint, compositing, filters, masks, and backend-facing drawing data.
owners.text: surgeist-text: fonts, shaping, line breaking, text measurement, and text layout.
owners.animation: surgeist-animation: timing, interpolation, sampled values, and animation/transition execution.
owners.runtime: surgeist-runtime: lifecycle, events/effects, observation delivery, invalidation scheduling, and frame orchestration.
owners.window: surgeist-window: window, viewport, input, and platform-host contracts.
owners.root: surgeist: cross-crate composition, resource/host adapters, and integration contracts. Includes future speech/HTML-facing integration without inventing a new crate.

supersession_records.scope: For a scope nested within a style rule, the selected Nesting section 3.3.1 specializes the older Cascade 6 section 2.5.3 body semantics: a scope-start nesting selector refers to the nearest ancestor style rule, while nesting selectors in the scope body and scope-end refer to :where(:scope). Retain Cascade 6 boundary grammar and scope ancestry. This overlap does not replace the whole Cascade module or make an unstyled scope admit declarations; matching and specificity execution remain downstream.

The selected MQ5 edition explicitly extends and supersedes MQ4 features. Use its effective query and feature definitions once while retaining MQ4 module membership and historical feature/source identities. Custom media and execution requirements remain separately owned and must not be inferred complete from implemented feature rows.
MQ5 section 1.1 explicitly supersedes MQ3 as well as MQ4. Retain MQ3 Snapshot membership, the historical source and stable feature IDs while attributing current authored grammar to MQ5.
Container-query definitions moved to Conditional Rules 5. Preserve Containment 3 membership as source history and use one effective grammar.
Discontinued W3C draft replaced by the canonical WHATWG standard.
Replace the old authored spelling with the published flow-tolerance property. No compatibility alias is selected.
Use the published display-mode grammar and keyword set; remove the repository-baseline claim for this standard feature.
Use the selected dated publication for the complete applicable authored grammar instead of the former source-repository pin.

normative_definitions.scope: Only the listed required definitions are imported. These source documents are not additional fully selected modules and do not change expected_counts or modules.

sources.source_resolution: Shapes 1 CRD 2025-06-12 explicitly imports SVG 1.1 Second Edition path grammar and parsing rules. Import only the path definitions below, without selecting SVG in full or upgrading to SVG 2.
Shapes 1 CRD 2025-06-12 explicitly imports SVG 1.1 Second Edition path grammar and parsing rules. Import only the path definitions below, without selecting SVG in full or upgrading to SVG 2.

Latest published Scoping 1 at the cutoff. Section 3.2.1 defines the three host signatures. This edition does not define ::slotted(); its obsolete shadow-tree model and other selectors are not imported.

Selectors 4 explicitly references CSS Shadow 1. Its editor source identifies Scoping 1 as its predecessor, but no dated Shadow 1 publication is available at the cutoff and the last published Scoping edition lacks ::slotted(). This full source revision pins only the referenced ::slotted() definition; it does not replace any selected module edition or select the editor draft in full.
Latest published Shadow Parts 1 at the cutoff. Import only the ::part() authored grammar; part/exportparts markup, maps, and APIs remain outside this CSS definition import.

The latest published edition before the cutoff is 2024-03-21, established from W3C version metadata and publication history inspected on 2026-09-12. Values 4 links living numeric-type algorithms despite an older bibliography date; the catalog latest-published policy selects this dated edition for only the required numeric definitions. This does not select Typed OM browser APIs or the module in full.

The selected MQ5 custom-media and Conditional Rules 5 named-supports grammars import extension-name from CSS Extensions 1. No published edition was found in the W3C publication inventory or the linked editor document metadata inspected on 2026-09-12. The source identifies itself as an Exploring editor draft and has no TR publication metadata. Pin the latest source-file commit before the cutoff, using its committer timestamp, only for the required extension-name production. This does not select the module or its other extension APIs.

Latest published edition before the cutoff, confirmed from the latest-publication metadata and history on 2026-09-13. The selected immutable Fullscreen snapshot explicitly moves its backdrop definition to Position 4. Import only the backdrop identity and fully-styleable classification required to compose selected pseudo-element grammar; Position 4 is not selected in full.

The selected Content 3 content-list grammar directly references attr(). Import only Values 5 sections 3.1.1, 3.3 and 7.7 for comma-containing function arguments, syntax and ordinary-property pending substitution behavior. Optional-comma omission follows the already selected Values 4 section 2.1. The 2024-11-11 publication is already pinned for other narrow definitions; this does not select Values 5 in full. Its illustrative <number px> spellings are inconsistent with the normative <syntax> production and are not adopted.

Latest published Values 5 edition before the cutoff, confirmed from W3C publication history on 2026-09-19. Conditional Rules 5 section 6.1 explicitly refers to tree-counting functions. Import only section 9 authored signatures and numeric integration for container size queries; Values 5 is not selected in full.

The selected 2021-12-24 Syntax 3 publication lacks block-contents, which selected Conditional Rules 5 and Nesting 1 reference. Pin the latest source-file revision before the cutoff for only that production and its scoped block-parsing dependencies. Preserve the selected published Syntax 3 edition, tokenizer and other entry points. The definition record explicitly reconciles a missing terminal declaration transfer; this source is not adopted unqualified or selected in full.

Latest published Env 1 edition before the cutoff, identified by the latest-publication metadata inspected on 2026-09-19. Selected Fonts 4 section 9.2 expressly permits env() in descriptor values. Import only the required authored function grammar, property/descriptor pending semantics, shorthand behavior and environment-reference identity; this does not select the module, device-variable inventory or environment APIs in full.

Selected Color 5 sections 3.2 and 3.3 directly reference the Values 5 editor definitions of mix item and normalize mix percentages. The latest published Values 5 edition before the cutoff remains 2024-11-11 and lacks those definitions, despite being named by the Color 5 bibliography. Pin only the required definitions from the latest source-file revision before the cutoff, using its committer timestamp. Preserve the separate published tree-counting import; this source is not a later published edition, a whole-module replacement, or selection of Values 5 in full.

The existing Values 5 publication-history evidence selects 2024-11-11 as the latest published edition before the cutoff. Selected Sizing 4 section 3.2 directly requires its calc-size() definition. Import only the function grammar, numeric typing and specified simplification, with interpolation and used-value requirements assigned downstream. This neither replaces the selected Values 4 edition nor selects Values 5 or interpolate-size in full.

Text 4 section 1.4 cites UAX29 for the extended grapheme cluster baseline. Import only revision 47's default extended grapheme cluster boundaries, including rules GB1 through GB999, for intrinsic single-character validation in text alignment. Language- or font-dependent tailoring and other Unicode segmentation algorithms are not imported.

Selected Overflow 3 section 3.2 imports Box 4 section 2.3 <visual-box> for overflow-clip-margin. Selected Position 3 section 3.2 directly refers to Box 4 section 3.2 four-side margin assignment, which establishes top/right/bottom/left repetition for inset. Only these two definitions are imported; Box 4 is not selected in full.

The selected Shapes 1 publication directly imports Values 5 position grammar. Reuse the already pinned latest published Values 5 edition before the cutoff, importing only section 4.2 position parsing and serialization. This does not select Values 5 in full or broaden other position consumers to a newer grammar.

required_by.requirement: The path() string must satisfy SVG 1.1 path grammar and parsing rules. Fill grammar is shared with selected Shapes/Masking nonzero/evenodd; SVG painting execution is not imported.

authored_requirements: Admit signed and zero arc radii under the adopted Appendix F.6.2 interpretation, preserving spelling without numeric correction. Keep lexical flags single ASCII 0/1; Appendix F.5/F.6.2 interpretation questions remain separately recorded.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Geometry, arc radius correction, zero-radius conversion, drawing-prefix recovery and SVG painting execution remain downstream; no full SVG profile is selected.

required_by.requirement: The path() string must satisfy SVG 1.1 path grammar and parsing rules. Fill grammar is shared with selected Shapes/Masking nonzero/evenodd; SVG painting execution is not imported.

authored_requirements: Validate the complete nonempty decoded path with SVG whitespace, maximal numbers, all command arities and single ASCII 0/1 flags; malformed suffixes reject the entire CSS value.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Geometry, arc radius correction, zero-radius conversion, drawing-prefix recovery and SVG painting execution remain downstream; no full SVG profile is selected.

required_by.requirement: Text 4's typographic-character discussion requires extended grapheme clusters as its baseline; the text-align string's single-character restriction requires an intrinsic, reproducible authored validation unit.
Validate the decoded alignment string against exactly one default extended grapheme cluster under the localized text-align reconciliation.

authored_requirements: Accept exactly one nonempty default extended grapheme cluster in the decoded text-align string, independent of source escapes, UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 code units, or Unicode scalar count.
Use revision 47's default extended boundary rules without contextual language or font tailoring. Preserve the authored string component and its provenance.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Contextual typography, font- and language-sensitive tailoring, table-cell character search and placement are outside this intrinsic authored validation import. Other UAX29 algorithms are not selected.

required_by.requirement: The named host forms are syntactically allowed after an element-backed pseudo-element but never match there. Their identities and argument grammars are needed to preserve this syntax-versus-matching distinction.

authored_requirements: Recognize the non-functional :host form and the two functional forms.
Each functional argument is one nonempty compound selector, using the selected Selectors 4 grammar; a comma-separated list, top-level combinator, or pseudo-element is not that production.
Preserve syntactically valid uses after an element-backed pseudo-element even when the selected Pseudo-Elements rule says they never match.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Shadow-tree construction, tree context, matching, and live APIs are deferred. The 2014 shadow-tree execution model is not adopted by this authored grammar import.

required_by.requirement: Normative query-container rules distinguish ::slotted() selectors and their represented elements; CSS must retain this authored selector while style evaluates the container context.

The getComputedStyle algorithm parses a pseudo-element selector and separately identifies ::slotted() as a disallowed argument. Its authored identity and grammar are distinct from the deferred live API behavior.

informative_correspondence.role: Section 16 gives ::slotted() suffix behavior as a Note and references CSS Shadow 1. The Note corroborates the dependency but does not independently select all Shadow 1 features.

authored_requirements: The argument is one nonempty compound selector under the selected Selectors 4 grammar.
Allow the tree-abiding pseudo-element suffix defined in this section, composed with applicable selected Selectors 4 and Pseudo-Elements 4 syntax rules.
Preserve specificity equal to one pseudo-element plus the specificity of the argument.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Slot assignment and flattening, represented-element matching, container selection, and getComputedStyle execution are deferred. No general shadow-tree API or :has-slotted feature is imported.

required_by.requirement: The named ::part() form participates in the normative syntactically-allowed versus never-matches distinction for element-backed pseudo-elements.
Normative query-container rules distinguish ::part() selectors and their represented elements.
The getComputedStyle algorithm distinguishes parsed ::part() selectors from other pseudo-element arguments before rejecting them for that API.

authored_requirements: Require one or more CSS identifier components using <ident>+; an empty argument or comma-separated list does not match the production.
Use <ident>, not <custom-ident>; do not invent CSS-wide keyword exclusions.
Preserve syntactically valid suffixes required by the selected Pseudo-Elements 4 rules without converting never-matches restrictions into parse errors.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Part maps, part/exportparts markup and forwarding, matching, shadow-tree inheritance, container selection, and live APIs are deferred.

required_by.requirement: Mathematical expression admission uses numeric dimension types, percent hints, matching, addition, multiplication and inversion to determine intrinsic grammar compatibility.

authored_requirements: Represent dimension exponents and a contextual percent hint without evaluating authored numeric values.
Apply the imported type addition, multiplication, inversion and percent-hint algorithms when checking the selected Values 4 mathematical grammar.
Match resulting numeric types against the owning grammar context, keeping integer conversion and deferred value ranges distinct from dimensional typing.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Arithmetic execution, environment-dependent substitution, unit resolution, integer rounding and contextual clamping remain downstream. CSSStyleValue objects, DOM maps, JavaScript reification and other Typed OM APIs are not imported.

required_by.requirement: Custom-media definition names use the extension-name production, and boolean media features reference those authored names.
Named supports definitions and references use the extension-name production for decoded, case-sensitive identifiers beginning with two hyphens, including the bare two-hyphen name.

authored_requirements: Accept an identifier whose decoded value starts with two U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS characters, including the bare two-hyphen identifier and identifiers consisting only of additional hyphens.

Preserve the authored identifier and source origin without borrowing the distinct custom-property-name exclusion of the bare two-hyphen identifier; custom-media and named-supports public name types remain distinct.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Custom-media and named-supports definition environments, last-definition selection, cycle handling, logical query evaluation, script-defined extensions and live CSSOM behavior remain downstream. Custom selectors, custom properties and functions from CSS Extensions 1 are not imported.

required_by.requirement: The selected Fullscreen publication moves the backdrop pseudo-element definition to CSS Position 4 and supplies fullscreen backdrop styling.
The fully-styleable classification determines membership in the tree-abiding pseudo-element family, including composition with the imported slotted suffix grammar.

authored_requirements: Retain the backdrop pseudo-element identity and classify it as fully styleable, hence tree-abiding, for contextual pseudo-element syntax.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Top-layer membership, generated boxes, originating elements, user-agent styles, stacking and painting remain downstream. This import does not select overlay or the rest of Position 4.

required_by.requirement: Size queries explicitly use tree-counting functions relative to the query container; authored numeric syntax must retain these functions without evaluating their tree context.

authored_requirements: Admit the two argument-free tree-counting function signatures in container size numeric contexts and retain their function identity and original token origins.
Treat their symbolic integer results as dimensionless numbers in the existing numeric type algebra; validate the enclosing length or ratio domain without tree evaluation.
Preserve these contextual functions through checked container construction and canonical serialization without enabling unrelated Values 5 functions or replacing the selected Values 4 module.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Query-container selection, flat-tree and originating-element context, integer evaluation, dependency tracking and invalidation remain downstream. Other Values 5 definitions are not imported by this record.

required_by.requirement: The container rule body uses block-contents; its own selected conditional-group rules establish valid children and contextual meaning.

The supports-condition rule body uses block-contents to retain an ordered, generic feature-test candidate tree. Its validity predicate and non-style role are defined separately from ordinary style and rule-list consumers.
Nested group bodies use block-contents; sections 3.3, 3.4 and 5 require ordered declaration runs and preservation of declarations after child rules.

authored_requirements: Use the category-neutral block-contents production only where selected rules reference it; the owning rule defines valid declarations and child rules. Its spelling alone neither permits every at-rule nor establishes style ancestry.

Retain accepted declarations and child rules in authored order, including declaration-only bodies and final declaration runs at a closing brace or EOF. Apply the explicit terminal-retention and named-supports test-body reconciliations below.

Use the listed block parser, rule/declaration consumers, component consumers, result records and token-stream operations only as dependencies of those selected block-contents contexts. Preserve contextual validation, recovery boundaries and parent-specific declaration materialization.

This import does not replace the selected 2021 stylesheet/declaration-list entry points or tokenizer, import unrelated unicode-range tokenization, or establish page placement, selector matching or live CSSOM behavior. Other selected contexts retain their own defining requirements.

localized_reconciliation.conflict: The consumer accumulates accepted declarations in decls but returns only rules at lines 2837-2840. No surrounding entry, block, rule or token-stream operation transfers that pending list. Literal execution loses declaration-only bodies and trailing runs, contrary to selected Nesting retention requirements.
localized_reconciliation.adopted_behavior: For selected style and style-nested group contexts, append the current nonempty accepted declaration list exactly once before returning at EOF or a closing brace. Preserve prior flush/reset order and the parent distinction between leading declarations and nested declaration rules. The independently admitted Conditional 5 named-supports test body also retains its nonempty final declaration run exactly once as test candidates; it does not materialize those candidates as styles. Other contexts must independently admit declarations and define their role; this reconciliation does not make rejected declarations valid.
localized_reconciliation.scope: A localized source reconciliation with explicit selected retention requirements, not a claim that the pinned algorithm contains the missing step, not a replacement source revision, and not an undefined-CSS or general later-source-precedence exemption.

named_supports_test_body_reconciliation.conflict: Conditional 5's mixed block-contents and declaration-only example require retained feature-test candidates. Ordinary rule-list or style-block validity filters discard unknown feature grammar or turn declarations into rendered styles; the pinned generic block algorithm leaves candidate validity to its consumer.
named_supports_test_body_reconciliation.adopted_behavior: Treat the body as ordered non-style test candidates: structurally formed declarations, qualified rules and at-rules survive without requiring known property, selector, descriptor or rule grammar. Try declaration structure before qualified-rule fallback, retaining the generic curly-block and custom-property-lookalike guards. Remove only a terminal !important annotation from a declaration candidate's semantic value; earlier ! tokens remain authored content. Flush nonempty declaration runs around rules and retain the final run once. Missing-colon items without a block and malformed lexical items recover locally, preserving valid siblings and the enclosing definition; implicit EOF closures retain diagnostics. Typed resource failures invalidate the definition, and strict construction rejects recovered bodies. The definition and all nested tests normalize as one terminal non-style payload without style declarations or selector contexts.
named_supports_test_body_reconciliation.scope: An authored retention and recovery reconciliation for named supports conditions only. Conditional 5 does not specify each malformed-candidate result here; this record neither changes ordinary supports declaration operands nor supplies condition evaluation, definition activation or live CSSOM behavior.

definitions.downstream_requirements: Mutable CSSOM objects and identity, matching, cascade execution, invalidation and application of conditional rules remain downstream. Authored ordering and intrinsic recovery remain CSS responsibilities.

required_by.requirement: The selected content property includes attr() as authored generated content.
The content-list production directly references attr(), importing its authored argument grammar.

authored_requirements: Admit the selected attr-name, optional direct <syntax> and optional comma/fallback grammar in ordinary known-property values. A present fallback needs one or more declaration-value component tokens; whitespace counts as fallback content, while comments alone do not. Braced fallback tokens must satisfy the strict declaration-value grammar.

Interpret bracketed type names and bare keyword alternatives ASCII case-insensitively under the selected Values 4 keyword rules; a quoted syntax string decodes and parses as the same <syntax>. Do not admit later type() syntax or the publication's illustrative <number px> spelling as normative grammar.

Retain complete original components, source origin and importance for qualifying whole-property pending values. Strict checked replacement reentry rejects residual attr() and ordinary invalid grammar without resolving attributes, selecting fallbacks or changing descriptor/query admission policies.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Style supplies attribute lookup with the applicable namespace environment, syntax-directed value substitution, fallback choice, URL-taint enforcement, computed-value invalidation and cascade. Root integration supplies host context. A reusable authored syntax model remains CSS-owned work; this slice uses checked retained components without claiming that model is complete. The import does not select all of Values 5.

required_by.requirement: User-defined font palette descriptor values expressly admit env() and evaluate in the root element context; the referenced function definition supplies shared property and descriptor substitution syntax.

authored_requirements: Interpret environment names, optional integer indices and fallback token streams using the imported function grammar and the selected Values and Syntax definitions. Preserve original components and provenance without environment lookup.

Retain substitution-dependent property and descriptor values wherever the function definition requires parse-time grammar deferral; preserve shorthand pending semantics until complete replacement values are available.
Keep intrinsic substitution-function validity, permissive declaration-value contexts and cross-function composition distinct when applying the selected normative definitions.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Environment values, index lookup, fallback selection, computed substitution, dependency tracking and invalidation require downstream context. Fonts 4 defines root-element context for its descriptors. Env 1 issue-9ee89738 leaves broader insertion locations unspecified; issue-42f9a2dd and issue-9806265e leave aspects of substitution timing unspecified. These individual omissions do not remove the explicit authored property/descriptor requirements. Device-variable inventories, author-definition APIs and the rest of Env 1 are not imported.

required_by.requirement: Color mix percentages use the referenced mix normalization algorithm.
Color mix calculation normalizes its ordered mix items with force normalization enabled and uses the returned leftover percentage to determine the alpha multiplier.

authored_requirements: Retain each authored mix item as its color and optional weight, including order, omission, exact ordinary coefficients, symbolic calculations and provenance; parsing is not normalization or color evaluation.

Use selected Color 5 and Values 4 for authored grammar, numeric range phases and context-independent specified serialization. Importing this algorithm does not replace those definitions or defer CSS-owned authored serialization to contextual execution.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Resolved color computation applies the imported six-step normalization algorithm with the force-normalization flag enabled as selected Color 5 requires, preserving its original total for leftover calculation and its zero-total branch. Color 5 owns singleton handling, ordered interpolation and alpha multiplication; contextual colors and execution require their downstream owners. This record does not claim implemented normalization, interpolation or complete color serialization. Other Values 5 mix, interpolate and substitution functions are not imported.

required_by.requirement: The shared box-size production explicitly includes calc-size(), referring to Values 5 for its definition across physical and flow-relative sizing properties.

authored_requirements: Admit the complete calc-size basis/calculation grammar with length-percentage numeric typing; restrict intrinsic keywords by the owning sizing category and exclude none as a basis.

Admit the length-valued size keyword only in the calculation argument when its basis is not any. Do not admit contextual size in a basis sum or ordinary numeric construction, including before simplification removes a term.

Preserve nested bases, symbolic numeric values, intrinsic identity and original origins through checked construction and bounded canonical specified serialization. Apply specified math simplification to each sum without performing interpolation canonicalization.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Style/layout supply intrinsic-size, containing-block, percentage and used-value context. Animation owns the separately defined canonicalize-for-interpolation operation, including basis substitution and de-percentification with bounded expansion. CSS authored serialization does not flatten nested bases or select layout values. This import does not select the adjacent interpolate-size property or unrelated Values 5 functions.

required_by.requirement: The overflow-clip-margin grammar directly imports the visual-box production.

authored_requirements: Accept exactly content-box, padding-box or border-box as the optional visual-box component of overflow-clip-margin, in either order with an optional nonnegative length. Preserve omission and reject all other box-edge keywords at checked construction.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Computed clip-edge geometry, layout and painting remain downstream. Importing visual-box does not select CSS Box 4 in full.

signatures: Four-side value assignment: first top, second right, third bottom, fourth left; omitted values repeat by one-, two-, or three-value rules.

required_by.requirement: The inset shorthand directly refers to margin's four-side value assignment.

authored_requirements: Preserve one to four authored inset values and assign their physical roles by the Box 4 margin repetition rule; Logical 1 adds the logical role order without resolving reset membership.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Computed positioned offsets, writing-mode mapping, and used-value layout remain downstream. This narrow import does not select CSS Box 4 in full.

required_by.requirement: The basic-shape circle and ellipse productions directly import the position definition from Values 5.

authored_requirements: Retain the physical, logical and relative one-, two- and four-component position alternatives, their axis ordering and checked specified values according to the imported grammar. Background three-component syntax is a separate production.

Apply context-independent position parsing and specified serialization without resolving writing modes, reference boxes or percentage bases. Preserve Cartesian axis identity and named or relative flow keyword families; physical-only consumers retain their narrower selected grammar.
definitions.downstream_requirements: Writing-mode mapping, reference-box selection, percentage resolution and used clipping geometry require downstream context. Those contextual requirements do not defer CSS-owned logical and relative authored grammar. Other Values 5 functions and position consumers remain outside this narrow import.

property_source.status: Exploring Editor's Draft, drafted for discussion without Working Group consensus; no dated Filter Effects 2 publication is selected.

modules.grammar_basis: The repository snapshot remains immutable historical grammar evidence. The named backdrop-filter property's value grammar, none initial and noninheritance follow property_source section 2. Its imported filter-value-list and function grammar/defaults resolve to the already selected Filter Effects 1 WD 2018-12-18 sections 5 and 6.1; canonical order and specified serialization follow that selected Level 1 sections 5 and 6.3.
